purpose: File.tree_relative_path (starlarkbuildapi/FileApi.java:133-143): on a tree artifact's expanded file (Artifact.TreeFileArtifact.getTreeRelativePathString, actions/Artifact.java:1148-1150) the path below the tree, as an expanded directory's files reach an Args map_each (add_all/add_joined) or DirectoryExpander.expand; on any other File (a source file, the tree itself) reading it is `tree_relative_path not allowed for files that are not tree artifact files.` (Artifact.java:549-552), getattr with a default included (Starlark.getattr calls the field, Starlark.java:985-992); the field is listed by dir() and hasattr() on every File. The expanded files' path/short_path/basename/dirname/extension/is_*/owner/root/repr/str are captured too. Motivation: bazel-rs 0.4.25 building //src/beyondwork.ai/bworker/cmd/monolith:image_push on ~/code failed `image_push_index#1: ... map_each failed: ... 'File' value has no field or method 'tree_relative_path' --> @@rules_oci+//oci/private:image_index.bzl:97:44`.

comparison (tests/tree_relative_path.rs,: MATCH: success equal; WARNING lines equal; a failing case's message contained; the top-level outputs (the spawn's expanded command line, the parameter file, the hasattr/dir facts) equal. DECLARED_DIVERGENCE: native fails with the recorded message.
